substantiveCommits.message: qa: enforce gate integrity inside core evaluator
qa: record core evaluator enforcement rule

finding.summary: The exact owner-approved Visual Fidelity Gate and reviewed-evidence exact-set checks were strongly enforced by MenuItem validators, but the public core evaluator could be invoked directly by -executeMethod, reflection, or another runner entry point without traversing those menu validators.
priorCoreBehavior: QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.ValidateConfig enforced threshold 92, native 3840x2160, nine category IDs, weights summing to 100, and only a coarse critical-defect-count floor.
Exact per-category weights/hard minima and the exact canonical twelve critical-defect IDs lived in QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA.

Duplicate/unknown reviewed categories, duplicate/unknown critical-defect reviews, mandatory correctiveAction text, and exact reviewed-entry counts lived in QualityBlockReviewedVisualEvidenceIntegrityQA.
Render provenance was already intrinsic to the core evaluator, so this finding concerns scoring-schema integrity rather than still-image byte provenance.
finding.risk: A non-menu caller could theoretically evaluate a rebalanced or otherwise weakened but still 100-point-total configuration, or bypass reviewed-document exact-set hardening, creating a false PASS path even though normal editor UI remained guarded.

changes: QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.ValidateGateConfig now invokes QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA.ValidateContract from inside the core method.
QualityBlockVisualFidelityGate.EvaluateVisualGate now invokes QualityBlockReviewedVisualEvidenceIntegrityQA.ValidateReviewedEvidence before reading/scoring category values.
visual_gate_integrity_contract.json now records the core-entrypoint enforcement requirement so later refactors cannot silently move protection back to menu-only validation.

sourceChecks: Fetched the modified core evaluator after commit and confirmed intrinsic gate-integrity and reviewed-evidence calls are present before category scoring.
Compared start HEAD to substantive work HEAD: only the core evaluator and machine-readable gate-integrity contract changed; no unrelated project paths changed.

Confirmed the new calls do not create recursive validation: QualityBlockVisualGateIntegrityQA validates configuration and reviewed-contract schema, while QualityBlockReviewedVisualEvidenceIntegrityQA validates the reviewed document and neither calls the core evaluator.

expectedVisualScoreImpactWhenRenderedAnd.effect: No visual pixels were changed. The improvement is that any future >=92 result must survive the immutable exact category weights/minima, exact twelve critical defects, reviewed-entry integrity, and existing render provenance even when the evaluator is invoked outside the editor menu.

nextBlocker: Actual Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and runtime execution. At first availability, stop speculative expansion and run the complete native 4K review packet, then inspect actual hero/oblique/grazing frames, 100% crops, and sealed temporal evidence before assigning any Visual Fidelity points.
nextSourceSideTargetIfRuntimeStillUnavai: Bind the supplemental rooftop period-authenticity crops into sealed render evidence/provenance rather than relying only on their separate exact-texel extraction manifest, so every crop cited for scoring is cryptographically tied to the same capture session.
note: This run strengthens score validity rather than image appearance. Implementation Readiness remains separate from Visual Fidelity and cannot contribute visual points.
